companyAnnouncements: smorinlabs-skills: the public cross-platform (Claude Code + Codex) plugin marketplace for smorinlabs: 16 plugins covering project tracking, code review, technical communication, CI and repo hygiene, and session management. Commands: /project-next and /project-add (roadmap in PROJECTS.md), /skill-create (add or update a plugin skill), /skill-quality (gate a skill before it ships), /skill-harness-release (cut a release). Regenerate manifests with `just gen`. Placement rules: smorin-skills/docs/skills-placement-strategy.md. Install: `/plugin marketplace add smorinlabs/smorinlabs-skills`.
